title: שְגָא
content:
[Str7680,7679] † [שְגָא] vb. grow great (Targum ´ס:, Syr. ܣ; v. BH שגא (Aramaism in Job);—Pe. Impf. 3 ms, יִשְגֵּא, of injury Ezr 4:22; ´שְׁלָֽמְכוֺן יִשְ: Dn 3:31, 6:26.

[Str7690] שַגִּרא adj. great, much;— abs. ´ש: Dn 2:6 + , fpl. שֵגִּיאָן 2:48, Ezr 5:11;—l. great, of image Dn 2:31 (in vision), height of tree 4:7 (id.); of honour 2:6. 2. much, fruit 4:9, 4:18, flesh 7:5; pl. many, years Ezr 5:11, gifts Dn 2:48. 3. as adv. exceedingly, 2:12, 5:9, 6:15, 6:24, 7:28.

[Str7717,7717,5707] † [שָֽהֲדוּ] n.f. testimony (√ שְהַד = Targum סְהַד testify, Syr. ܣܗܕ, Ar. شَهِدَ testify, cf. BH [שָהֵד] (once, as loan-wd.) KAram. 86; Eg. Aram. pl. שהדיאֹ witnesses Cooke404 S-CA. 15 + oft.);—emph. שָֽהֲדוּתָא Gn 31:47 (‖ BH עֵד).

title: שוּם
content: [Str7760–61] [שוּם], שים vb. set, make (v. BH; for Pers. infl. on usage cf. Scheft65);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. שָם Ezr 5:3 +, sf. שָמֵהּ 5:14; 2 ms, שַ֫מְתָּ Dn 3:10 1 S. שָ֫מֶת טְעֵם Ezr 6:12; 3 mpl. שָמוּ Dn 3:12; Imv. mpl שִ֫ימוּ Ezr 4:21;—1. make, acc. טְעֵם = make decree Dn 3:10, Ezr 6:1, 6:12 + vb. fin. v:8, + inf. 4:21, 5:13 and (c. ל Pers.) v:3, v:9. 2. make, appoint, one’s name Dn 5:12 (2 acc.), one to office Ezr 5:14 (2 acc.). 3. set, fix, acc. בָּל mind, Dn 6:15 (c. inf.); acc. טְעֵם 3:12, 6:14 pay due regard (טְעֵם) to (עַל Pers.). Pe‘îl 3 ms. מִנִּי שִים טְעֵם Ezr 4:19, from me a decree is made, so 5:17, 6:8, 6:11, 7:13, 7:21, Dn 3:29, 4:3, 6:27; lit. 3 fs. שֻמַת (rd. prob. שִימַת K§ 45, Belsp. 1. d)) 6:18 (of stone, עַל loc.). Hithpe. be made: Impf. 3 ms. יִתְּשָם Ezr 4:24 (of decree, סטְעֵס c. מִן agent.); 3 mpl. יִתְּשָמוּן Dn 2:5 subj. rei + n. pred. be made into; Pt. Ezr 5:8 lit. be set, laid, of wood, ב of wall.

title: שְטַר
content: [Str7859] † שְטַר n.m. side (Eg. Aram. S-CA 5; Targum סְטַר, סִטְרָא, Syr. ܣܛܪܐ, Chr-Pal. ܣܛܪ SchulthLex, 134, of. SchwallyIdiot. 62, 122; Ar. شَطرٌ half);-abs. ´ש: Dn 7:5 (of beast in vision).

title: שִיב
content: [Str7868–69] † [שִיב] vb. be hoary (v. BH);—Pe. Pt. pl. as subst. = elders, term. techn., abs. שָבֵי יְהוּדָיֵא Ezr 5:5, 6:7, 6:8, 6:14; so emph. שָבַיָּא 5:9.

title: שְכַל
content:
[Str7920,7919] † [שְכַל] vb. Hithpe. consider, contemplate (vBH I. שכל);—Pt. מִשְתַּכַּל Dn 7:8 (ב rei).

[Str7924] † שָכְלְתָנוּ (K§ 61 ,4)) n.f. insight;—Dn 5:11, 5:12, 5:14.

title: שְנָא
content:
[Str8131,8130] † [שְנָא] vb. hate (Targum סְנָא, Syr. ܣܢܐ; v. BH שָנֵא);—Pe. Pt. pl. sf. שנאיך Kt, שָֽנְאָךְ Qr (K§ 53, 2, Anm. b)) Dn 4:16 = thy foes (BH 3, MI4 Sab).

[Str8177,8181] † שְעַר n.m.:Dn 3:27 hair, of head (Targum ´ס:, Syr. ܣ; v. BH I. שער);—cstr. Dn 3:27, 7:9; sf. שַׁעְרֵהּ 4:30.

title: שְׁאֵל
content:
[Str7592–93] שְׁאֵל vb. ask (v. BH);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. ´שׁ: Dn 2:10; pl. שְׁאֵ֫לְנָא Ezr 5:9, 5:10; Impf. 3 ms. sf. יִשְׁאֲלֶנְכוֺ Ezr 7:21; Pt. act. שָׁאֵל Dn 2:11, 2:27;—1. ask for, request, acc. rei Dn 2:10 (ל Pers.), v:11, v:27, Ezr 7:21 (sf. Pers.). 2. inquire about, for, acc. rei Ezr 5:9 (ל Pers.); sq. orat. rect. v:10 (id.).

[Str7595] † [שְׁאֵלָה] n.f. affair (weakened fr. question, inquiry, cf. Dr);—emph. שְׁאֵלְתָּא Dn 4:14.

[Str7605–06] † שְׁאָר n.m.:Ezr 7:20 rest, remainder (v. BH I. שׁאר; Eg. Aram. n. שאר Cooke203, vb. ישתאר be left (outstanding) Cooke404 = S-CL 9, Chr-Pal. ܫܐܪ);—´שׁ: abs. Ezr 4:10 +, cstr. v:9 +; emph. שְׁאָרָא Dn 7:7, 7:19;—of a thing, remainder Ezr 7:18, 7:20; of cities 4:10, 4:17, of persons v:9, v:10, v:17, 6:16, Dn 2:18, of beasts 7:7, 7:12, 7:19.

title: שׁבב
content:
† שׁבב (√ of foll.; cf. BH II. שׁבב).

[Str7631] [שְׁבִיב] n.[m.] flame;—emph. שְׁבִיבָא דִּי נוּרָא Dn 3:22; pl. abs. שְׁבִבִין דִּי נוּר 7:9.

title: שְׁבַךְ
content:
[Str7624,7623] † [שְׁבַךְ] vb. Pa. laud, praise (Targum Syr.; v. BH II. שׁבח (Aramaism));—Pf. 2 ms. שַׁבַָּחְךְָ Dn 5:23, 1 s. שַׁבְּחֵת 4:31, 3 mpl. שַׁבַּ֫חוּ 5:4; Pt. act. מְשַׁבַּח 2:23 4:34;—paise, c. ל dei Dn 2:23, 4:31, 4:34; ל of idols 5:4, 5:23.

[Str7625–26] † [שְׁבַט] n.m. tribe (BH שֵׁבֶט, √ שׁבט);—pl. cstr. שִׁבְטֵי יִשְרָאֵל Ezr 6:17.

title: שְׁבַע
content: [Str7655,7651] † [שְׁבַע], only שִׁבְעָה n.f. seven (BH I. שֶׁבַע);—abs. ´שׁ: bef. n.m. pl. Dn 4:13, 4:20, 4:22, 4:29; cstr. שֶׁבְעַת bef. n.m. pl.Ezr 7:14; חַד שִׁבְעָה עַל־דִּי Dn 3:19 seven times above what (more than), v. חַד, √ אחד.

title: שְׁבַק
content: [Str7662,7733] † [שְׁבַק] vb. leave, let alone (Targum שְׁבַק, Syr. ܫܒܩ; cf. BH, p. 990);—Pe. Inf. לְמִשְׁבַּק Dn 4:23 leave roots, so Imv. mpl. שְׁבֻ֫קוּ v:12, v:20 (both c. ב loc.); Ezr 6:7 let alone, c. ל acc. rei. Hithpe. Impf. 3 fs. תִּשְׁתְּבִק Dn 2:44 be left (of kingdom, + ל gent.).

title: שְׁבַשׁ
content:
[Str7672] † [שְׁבַשׁ] vb. Hithp. be perplexed (Targum id., entangle, beguile, NH שָׁבַשׁ confuse, disarrange; cf. As. šabâšu (šabasu), turn about; Syr. شبق flatter, allure, SchulthHom. Wurz. 90; so Mand. Pa. שבש NöM 49; cf. Ar. شَوَّشَ (as loan-word Nöl. c.) confuse);—Pt. pl. מִשְׁתַּבְּשִׁין Dn 5:9.

[Str7694–95] † [שֵׁגָל] n.f. (royal) consort (cf. BH id.; √ unknown HptGu Ezr-Ne, p. 65 conj. As. šigrêti, harem-women);—pl. sf. שֵֽׁגְלָתָךְ Dn 5:23, שֵֽׁגְלָתֵהּ v:2, v:3.

title: שְׁדַר
content:
[Str7712] † [שְׁדַר] vb. Hithpa. struggle, strive (Targum id. Pa. wrestle, Ithpa. be recalcitrant, also שְׁדַל Ithpa. strive, and so NH שָׁדַל (ל for ר), Syr. ܫܕܠ beguile, esp. Pa., v. NöZMG xi (1886) 735);—Pt. מִשְׁתַּדַּר Dn 6:15 he was striving, sq. Inf.

[Str849] ‡ † אֶשְׁתַּדּוּר n.m. revolt;—abs. Ezr 4:15, 4:19.

[Str7714–15] שַׁדְרַךְ:13 n.pr.m. (cf. BH id.);—Dn 2:49, 3:12 + 11 t. 3.

title: שׁדת
content:
[Str8337] שׁדת (√ of foll.; BH שׁדשׁ, שֵׁשׁ).

[Str8353] † שֵׁת, שִָׁת n.m. six;—abs. שִָׁת after .n.f.Dn 3:1; שְׁנָת־שֵׁת Ezr 6:15 year six = sixth year.

[Str8361] † שִׁתִּין n. indecl. sixty;—´אַמִּין שׁ: Ezr 6:3, 6:3, Dn 3:1; וְתַרְתֵּין ´שְׁגִין שׁ: 6:1.

title: I שְׁוָה
content: [Str7737,7739] †I. [שְׁוָה] vb. become like (BH I. שָׁוָה);—Pa. Pf. 3 mpl. שַׁוִּי Qr (v. וְ foll.; > Pe‘îl שְׁוִי Kt, v. K§ 47 Beisp. 3, and p. 175) Dn 5:21, acc. rei, c. עִם.

title: II שְׁוָה
content: [Str7739] †II. [שְׁוָה] vb. Hithpa. be set, made (Pa. שַׁוִּי make, Cappadoc. Aram. LzbEph. i. 67; cf. BH II. [שָׁוָה]);—Impf. 3 ms. יִשְׁתַּוֵּהָ Dn 3:29, subj. rei + acc. be made into something (K§ 84, 3).

title: שׁוק
content:
[Str7785] שׁוק (√ of following; BH I. שׁוק, שׁוֺק).

[Str8243] † [שָׁק] n.[m.] lower leg;—pl. sf. שָׁקוֺ֫הִי Dn 2:33.

[Str7791–92] † [שׁוּר] n.m. wall (cf. BH II. שׁוּר id.; Eg. Aram. שור RÉS361 A 5; B 1);—pl. emph. שׁוּרַיָּה Ezr 4:16, אָ֯ v:13, v:12 rd. ´שׁוּרַיָּא שׁ: Qr, for ´שׁורי אשׁ: Kt.

[Str7801] שׁוּשַׁנְכָיֵא n. pr. gent. pl. the Susians, people of Susa Ezr 4:9, v. דהוא (DlPa 327; sg. [שׁוּשַׁנָךְ] acc. to Scheft92, = OP * šušana-ka, from Susa, so (as altern.) AndrM 85 *; cf. (on Elam. god Šušinak) WeissbachAnzanische Inschr. 136 JenVOJ vi. 54 ZimKAT 3. 485, and (on Šušunḳa in Elam. inscr., appar. n.pr.terr.) v. Weissb1. c. JenZMG iv (1901), 229).

title: שְׁחַת
content:
[Str7844,7843]1115 † [שְׁחַת] vb. corrupt (TargumJ (once), Syr. ܫܚܛ; BH [שָׁחַת]);—Pe. Pt. pass. fs. שְׁחִיתָה Dn 2:9 corrupt word; as n. = fault 6:5, 6:5 (cf. Targum Psalm 17:3, Ru 4:22).

[Str7804,5800,4898] † שֵׁיזִב vb. deliver (prob. Shaph. as loan-word from As. šûzub(u), ušêib, deliver, √ ezêbu (א:4 = עזב), DlPr 140 HptGGN 1583, 91; BAS i.13 K§ 43, 1, Anm.; Targum שֵׁיזֵב, Syr. ܫܘܙܒ, Chr-Pal. ܫܘܙ ܒ SchulthLex. 203, also Nab. שיזב Cooke255; cf. n.pr. מְשֵׁיזַבְאֵל BH; OAram. צלמשזב SAC102; v. also foll. art.);—Pf. 3 ms. שֵׁיזִב Dn 3:28, 6:28; Impf. 3 ms. יְשֵׁיִ+זב 3:17; sf. יְשֵׁיזְבִנָּךְ 6:17, נְִ֯כבוֺן 3:13; Inf. sf. לְשֵׁיזָבוּתָךְ 6:21, הֵתּ- v:15, תַָנָּא- 3:17;—deliver (usu. c. מִן): Dn 3:17b, ל acc. Pers. v:28, 6:28 b, sf. Pers. 3:15, 3:17 a, 6:15, 6:17, 6:21, abs. v:28 a.

title: שׁיציא
content: [Str3319,3318] † שׁיציא Kt, שֵׁיצִי Qr vb. bring out (to an end), finish (prob. Shaph. as loan-word fr. As. šû-ṣû, û-še-ṣû, bring out, √ aṣû (וצא, BH יצא, = Aram. יְעָא, cf. NöGGA 1884, 1019), Dll. c. Hpt1. c. K1. c.; Targum שֵׁיצִי complete, put an end to, also come to an end, pass. be finished, Chr-Pal. ܫܝܨܝ SchulthLex. 205);—finish temple: Pf. 3 ms. ´שׁ: Ezr 6:15, but read prob. 3 mpl. שֵׁיצִיו K§ 43:1 ad fin. Berthol GuHpt (so LXX Vulgate); > Pf. pass. Be-Ry.

title: שׁכב
content:
[Str4904,7901] שׁכב (√ of foll.; BH שָׁכַב, מִשְׁכָּב).

[Str4903] † [מִשְׁכַּב] n.[m.] couch, bed;—sf. מִשְׁכְּבִי Dn 4:2, 4:7, 4:10; ךְָ֯ 2:28, 2:29; הֵּ֯ 7:1.

title: שְׁכַח
content:
[Str7912] † [שְׁכַח] vb. Haph. (K§ 40, 4 NöGGA 1884, 1019) find (Targum שְׁכַח find, Syr. ܐܫܟܚ, Chr-Pal. ܫܟܚ SchulthLex. 205; Eg. Aram. השכח S-CE 5, pass. אשתכךְ RÉS361A 2):—Pf. 1 s. הַשְׁכַּ֫חַת Dn 2:25; 3 mpl. הַשְׁכַּ֫חוּ Ezr 4:19, Dn 6:12; Impf. 2 ms. תְּהַשְׁכַּת Ezr 4:15, 7:16; Inf. לְהַשְׁכָּחָה Dn 6:5, 6:5;—find, acc. rei, 6:5 (ל Pers.), v:5, v:6 (ל Pers.), v:6 (עַל Pers., acc. rei om.), Ezr 7:16 (ב loc.); sq. cl. דִּי 4:15 (ב loc.), v:19; acc. Pers. Dn 2:25; ל Pers. 6:12 ( + pt. action.). Hithpe. Pf. 3 ms. הִשְׁתְּכַח Dn 2:35 +, 2 ms. כַ֫חַתְּ- 5:27, 3 fs. כַ֫חַת- 5:11 +;— be found, subj. rei, ב loc., Ezr 6:2; ב Pers. Dn 5:11, 5:12, 5:14, 6:24; עַל Pers. v:5; ל Pers. + קֳדָם Pers. v:23; ל rei 2:35 (v. אֲתַר); subj. Pers. 5:27 + חַסִּר thou hast been found wanting (K§ 85, 3).

[Str3635] שַׁכְלְלֵהּ etc., v. כלל

title: שְׁכֵן
content:
[Str4908,7931–32] † [שְׁכֵן cf. Targum] vb. dwell (BH שָׁכַן, מִשְׁכָּן);—Pe. Impf. 3 fpl. יִשְׁכְּנָן Dn 4:18 dwell, of birds, ב loc. Pa. causat.: Pf. 3 ms. שַׁכִּן שְׁמֵהּתַּמָּה Ezr 6:12, of God, cause his name to dwell there.

[Str4907] † [מִשְׁכַּן] n.[m.] abode, of God;—sf. מִשְׁכְּנֵהּ Ezr 7:15, of Jerusalem.

title: שׁלה
content:
[Str7951] שׁלה, שׁלו (√ of foll.; BH I. שׁלה (late)).

[Str7954] † שְׁלֵה adj. at ease (Eg.Aram.Cooke210);—הֲוֵית בְּ ´שׁ: Dn 4:1 I was at ease in my house.—3:29 v. following.

[Str7955,7960,7596] † שָׁלוּ n.f. neglect, remissness (Targum id.);—abs. ´שׁ: Ezr 4:22, 6:9, Dn 6:5 + 3:29 Qr; Kt שׁלה usu. thought an error for שׁלו; Hi Bev M (perhaps) expl. as שֵׁלָה = שְׁאֵלָה = thing, affair (4:14).

[Str7963] † [שְׁלֵוָה] n.f. ease, prosperity;—sf. שְׁלֵוְתָךְ Dn 4:24.

title: שְׁלַח
content: [Str7971–72] † שְׁלַח vb. send (BH I. שָׁלַח);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. ´שׁ: Ezr 4:17 +; 3 mpl. שְׁלַ֫חוּ 4:11 +; 2 mpl. שְׁלַחְתּוּן 4:18; 1 pl. שְׁלַחְנָא 4:14; Impf. 3 ms. יִשְׁלח 5:17, 6:12; Pt. pass. שְׁלִיחַ 7:14, Dn 5:24;—send, acc. of letter, etc., c. עַל Pers. Ezr 4:11, 4:17, 4:18, 5:6, 5:7, 5:17; abs. 6:13, sq. vb. fin. 4:14, + acc. Pers. Dn 3:28, 6:23; sq. Inf. Dn 3:2; send out hand (acc.) to harm (Inf.); pass., be sent, c. מִן־קֳדָם Pers.: subj. Pers. Ezr 7:14; subj. כַּפָּא Dn 5:24.

title: שְׁלֵט
content:
[Str7980–81] † שְׁלֵט vb. have power, rule (Targum Syr.; BH (q.v.) late);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. ´שׁ: Dn 3:27, 3 mpl. שְׁלִ֫טוּ 6:25; Impf. 3 ms. יִשְׁלַָט 5:7, 3 fs. תִּשְׁלַט 2:39, 2 ms. תִּשְׁלַָט 5:16;—have power upon, ב rei, Dn 3:27 (of fire); fall upon, assault (Targum = פָּגַע בְּ), ב Pers. 6:25 (of lions); subj. Pers. rule, be ruler, abs., 5:7, 5:16, subj. kingdom, ב of earth, 2:39. Haph. make ruler: Pf. 3 ms. sf. הַשְׁלְטָח 2:38 (ב Pers., etc.); הַשְׁלְטֵהּ v:48 (עַל of province).

[Str7985] † שָׁלְטָן (K§ 61. 3, Belsp, a)) n.m.:Dn 7:6 dominion;—´שׁ: abs. Dn 7:6, 7:14, cstr. 6:27 +; emph. שָׁלְטָנָא 7:27; sf. שָׁלְטָנָח 4:19, נֵהּ- 3:33 +, נְהוֺן- 7:12; pl. emph. שָׁלְטָנַיָּא 7:27;—1. dominion, sovereignty (usu. of God): Dn 3:33, 4:19, 4:31, 4:31, 6:27 b, 7:6, 7:12, 7:14, 7:14, 7:14, 7:26, 7:27, 7:27. 2. realm 6:27 a.

[Str7990] † שַׁלִּיט adj. having mastery, ruling;—abs. ´שׁ: Ezr 7:24 +, emph. אָ֯ Dn 2:15; mpl. שְׁלִיטִין Ezr 4:20, מִן- Dn 4:23;—1. having, exercising, mastery: a. of God, sq. ב, Dn 4:14, 4:22, 4:29, 5:21; abs., of heavens 4:23 b. of kings Ezr 4:20 (ב). 2. as n. = ruler Dn 2:10, captain v:15. 3. having authority to do a thing (Inf.), hence impers. = it is authorized, Ezr 7:24 (so oft. in Syr.; cf. S-CA 11 + אנת שליט למבנה).

title: שְׁלֵם
content:
[Str7999–8000] † [שְׁלֵם] vb. be complete (v. BH; Eg. Aram. שלם pay in full Cooke404 = S-CL 5. 7);—Pe. Pt. pass, שְׁלִם Ezr 5:16 finished, of temple. Haph. Pf. 3 ms. sf. הַשְׁלְמַהּ Dn 5:26 God has finished it (the kingdom; brought it to an end); Imv. ms. הַשְׁלֵם Ezr 7:19 render in full, acc. rei (cf. Syr. Aph., Be-Ry Berthol), sq. קֳדָם dei.

[Str8001] † שְׁלָם n.m.:Dn 3:31 welfare, prosperity;—in greetings: abs. Ezr 4:17 prosperity! emph. שְׁלָמָא 5:7; sf. שְׁלָֽמְכוֺן יַשְגִּיא Dn 3:31, 6:26.

[Str8034,8036] † שֻׁם n.m. name (v. BH שֵׁם);—cstr. ´שׁ: Ezr 5:1 +; sf. שְׁמֵהּ Dn 2:20 +; pl. cstr. שְׁמָהָת Ezr 5:4, sf. תְהֹם- v:10;—name, dei: Dn 2:20, 4:5, Ezr 5:1, 6:12; vir.: Dn 2:26, 4:15, 4:16, 5:12 (all Dan.), Ezr 5:4, 5:10, 5:10 also v:14, with which cf. S-CK 4, 5, s f., 12 f.

title: שְׁמַד
content:
[Str8046,8045] † [שְׁמַד] vb. Haph. destroy (Targum Pa. make apostatize; cf. BH);—Inf. לְהַשְׁמָדָה Dn 7:26 (obj. om., = dominion).

[Str8064–65,8064] † [שְׁמַ֫יִן] n.m. pl. heavens (BH [שָׁמַי], שָׁמַיִם, √ שׁמה);—alw. emph. שְׁמַיָּא: 1. visible sky Je 10:11, Dn 4:8, 4:10, 4:17, 4:19, 4:20, 4:27, 4:28; ´עוֺף שׁ: 2:38; ´חִפֲּרֵי שׁ: 4:9, 4:18; ´טַל שׁ: v:12, v:20, v:22, v:30, 5:21; ´רוּחֵי שׁ: 7:2 winds of the sky; ´עֲנָנֵי שׁ: v:13; heavens + earth = universe Je 10:11, where God shews signs Dn 6:28. 2.heavens as abode of God Dn 2:28, 4:31, hence, fig., as ruling v:23(´שׁ: sometimes = God in NHJAram., DWorte Jesu l79; Eng.Tr.2l8 f.); as abode of angels v:32 (Dr); elsewh. in phr. ´אֱלָהּ שׁ: 2:18, 2:19, 2:37, 2:44, Ezr 5:11, 5:12, 6:9, 6:10, 7:12, 7:21, 7:23, 7:23, ´מֶלֶךְ שׁ: Dn 4:34, ´מָרֵא שׁ: 5:23.

title: שְׁמַם
content: [Str8075,8074] † [שְׁמַם] vb. Ethpō‘l. be appalled (Targum (rare); v. BH; Chr-Pal. ܫܡ, Schulth209);—Pf. 3 ms. אֶשְׁתּוֺמַם (K§ 36) Dn 4:16.

title: שְׁמַע
content:
[Str8085–86] † שְׁמַע vb. hear (v. BH);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. ´שׁ: Dn 6:15; 1 s. שִׁמְעֵת 5:14, 5:16; Impf. 3 ms. יִשְׁמַע 3:10, 2:mpl. תִּשְׁמְעוּן 3:5, 3:15; Pt. act. שָֽׁמְעִין 3:7, 5:23;—hear: = have sense of hearing Dn 5:23; c. acc. of sound 3:5, 3:7, 3:10, 3:15, word 6:15; c. cl. דִּי + עַל Pers. concerning, 5:14, 5:16. Hithpe. shew oneself obedient: Impf. 3 mpl. יִשְׁתַּמְעוּן Dn 7:27, c. ל Pers. (prob.).

[Str8111,8115] † שָֽׁמְרָיִן n.pr.loc. (BH שֹׁמְרוֺן, I. שָׁמַר);—Ezr 4:7, 4:10.

title: I שׁמשׁ
content:
[Str8121] I. שׁמשׁ (√ of following; BH שׁמשׁ, שֶׁ֫מֶשׁ).

[Str8122] † [שְׁמַשׁ] n.[m. so DWB] sun;—emph. שִׁמְשָׁא Dn 6:15.

title: II שְׁמַשׁ
content:
[Str8120] †II. [שְׁמַשׁ] vb. Pa. minister (Targum Pa. id., תַּשְׁמִישׁ use; Palm. שמש, תשמיש, SAC114, cf. 122 Lzb379; Syr. شمش, ܐܫܡܫܬܐ; Chr-Pal.ܫܡܫ Pa, ܬܫܡܫ NH שִׁמֵּשׁ, תַּשְׁמִישׁ; Egypt. šms, servant, Kopt. šemše, cf. WMM in Buhl14);—Impf. 3 mpl. sf. יְשַׁמְּשׁוּנֵּתּ Dn 7:10 were ministering to him.

[Str8124] † שִׁמְשַׁי n.pr.m.;—always סָֽפְרָא ´שׁ:: Ezr 4:8, 4:9, 4:17, 4:23 (AndrM 86 * conj. OIran. caritative ששמי, conformed to שׁמשׁ, cf. Scheft92, who, however, prefers OBaktr. simēzhi = simaēzhi, n.pr.).

title: שֵׁן
content: [Str8128] שֵׁן v. שׁנן. below

title: שְׁנָא
content:
[שְׁנָא] vb. change (v. BH I. שׁנה);—Pe. Pf. 3 mpl. שְׁנוֺ Dn 3:27, sf. שְׁנוֺ֫הִי 5:6 (rd. prob. שְׁנוֺ עֲלוֺהִ); Impf. 3 ms. יִשְׁנֵא 7:24, 3 fs. תִּשְׁנֵא 6:18, 7:23; Pt. act. fs. שַׁנְיָא 7:19; mpl. שָׁנַ֫יִן 5:9, fpl. שָֽׁנְיָן 7:3;—intrans. change, be changed: of garment, by fire Dn 3:27, brightness (זִיו) of face 5:6, 5:9, purpose 6:18; be different from (מִן) 7:3, 7:19, 7:23, 7:24. Pa. Pf. 3 mpl. שַׁנִּי (K§ 47 e), and Beisp. 3) Dn 3:28; Impf. 3 mpl. יְשַׁנּוֺן 4:13; Pt. pass. fs. מְשַׁנְיָא (Baer) 7:7;—trans. change Dn 4:13 (לִבְבֵהּ מִן־אֲנָשָׁא); = frustrate word of king 3:28; pt. pass. intrans. different 7:7 (מִן). Ithpa. Pf. 3 mpl. אִשְׁתַּנּוֺ Dn 3:19 Kt (K§ 47, Belsp. 4; נִַּ֯ו NöGGA 1884, 1019 Str:§ 23 d M24 *), > 3 ms. אִשְׁתַּנִּי Qr; Impf. 3 ms. יִשְׁתַּנֵּא 2:9, 3 mpl. +נּוֺ- (ן om. in pause, K§ 26, 1, but modus apocop. NöGGA 1884, 1018, as יֵאבַ֫דוּ Je 10:11, יְהֲלוּךְ Dn 5:10; v. also Cooke166) 5:10, נוֺן- 7:28;—be changed: of זִיו Dn 5:10, 7:28 (v. Pe.; עַלPers.); חְלֵם אַנְפּוֺהִי 3:19 (id.); of time, conditions 2:9. Haph. Impf. 3 ms. יְהַשְׁנֵא Ezr 6:11; Inf. לְהַשְׁנָיָה v:12 +; Pt. act. מְהַשְׁנֵא Dn 2:21;—trans. change, alter, times, etc. (v. Ithpa.) Dn 2:21, 7:25; acc. om. 6:9, 6:16, Ezr 6:12; frustrate edict (v, Pa.) 6:11.

[Str8140,8139] †II. [שְׁנָה] n.f. year (v. BH שָׁנָה, √ I. [שָׁנָה]);—cstr. שְׁנַת: חֲדָה ´שׁ: = first year Ezr 5:13, 6:3, Dn 7:1; תַּרְתֵּין ´שׁ: Ezr 4:24 second year; שֵׁת ´שׁ: 6:15; pl. ´שְׁנִין שִׁתִּין וְת: Dn 6:1 62 years; שַגִּיאָן ´שׁ: Ezr 5:11.—I. [שְׁנָה ] v. ישׁן

title: שׁנן
content:
[Str8127,8150] שׁנן (√ of following; v. BH [שָׁנַן], שֵׁן).

[Str8128] † [שֵׁן] n.[f.] tooth;—du. (of rows of teeth) abs. שִׁנַּ֫יִן Dn 7:7;—sf. שניה Kt (K§ 53, 2. b)), שִׁנַּהּ Qr, v:5, v:19 (all of beasts in vision).

[Str8160] † שָׁעָה n.f. brief time, moment (Targum id., שָֽׁעֲתָא, NH שָׁעָה time, hour; Syr. ܫܥܬܐ moment, then hour Brock369, but Chr-Pal. ܫܥܐ moment, hour SchwallyIdiot. 97 SchulthLex. 211; perh. = As. šattu, duration; TelAm91, 77 še-ti, time, hour (as Canaanism) WklKAT 3. 335; Ar. سِعْوٌ, سَاعَةٌ portion of time, Eth. ስኣዕ፡ time, ሰዐት፡ hour, time (Buhl calls Ar. Eth. loan-words, but v.Wkll.c); √ unknown: poss. As. loan-word (v. Wkll.c); DlPr 39 f. conj.* שׁיע = שָׁעָה look, hence moment = ‘Augenblick,’ but vb. ´שׁ: rather of steadygaze);—moment: usu. emph. בַּהּ־שַׁעֲתָא (rd. poss. ´שָֽׁ: as Targum Syr., M86 * f. Buhl14 cf. var. in Str) in the same moment, forthwith Dn 3:6, 3:15, 4:30, 5:5; abs. שָׁעָה חֲדָה 4:16 for a moment.

title: שְׁפַט
content: [Str8199–200] ‡ † [שְׁפַט] vb. judge (BH שָׁפַט);—Pt. as n.pl. abs. שָֽׁפְמִין Ezr 7:25 judges.

title: שַׁפִּיר
content: [Str8209] שַׁפִּיר v. שׁפר. below

title: שְׁפֵל
content:
[Str8213–14] † [שְׁפֵל] vb. be low (v. BH);—Haph. bring low, humble: Pf. 2 ms הַשְׁפֵּלְתְּ לִבְבָח Dn 5:22 thou hast not humbled thine heart; Impf. 3 ms. יְהַשְׁפִָּל 7:24, Inf. לְהַשְׁפָּלָה 4:34, Pt. מַשְׁפִָּל 5:19, all c. acc. Pers. bring low, put down.

[Str8215] † שְׁפַל adj. low in station;—cstr. ´שׁ: Dn 4:14.

title: שְׁפַר
content:
[Str8232] † שְׁפַר vb. be fair, seemly (Targum Syr.; cf. BH (rare and mostly late); Palm. שפר ל merit well of, SAC117; Cappad. Aram. שפירא LzbEph. 160);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. ´שׁ:, c. קֳדָם Pers. it seemed good to Dn 3:32, 6:2; Impf. 3 ms. יִשְׁפַּר עַל 4:24 let my counsel be acceptable to thee.

[Str8209] † שַׁפִּיר adj. fair, beautiful;—of foliage Dn 4:9, 4:18.

[Str8238] † [שְׁפַרְפָּר] n.[m.] dawn (Targum id,; redupl. (K§ 59, 3) fr. above √ ?);—emph. שְׁפַרְפָּרָא Dn 6:20.

[Str8243] שָׁק v. שׁוק

title: שְׁרָא
content: [Str8271,8281] † [שְׁרָא] vb. 1. loosen. 2. abide (v.BH I. שׁרה);—Pe. Inf. לְמִשְׁרֵא Dn 5:16; rd. ´מִשׁ: also v:12, for ´מְשָׁ: (K§ 40 n M87 * al.);—Pt. pass. שְׁרֵא (K§ 47. Beisp. f)) 2:22; pl. שְׁרַיִן 3:25;—1. loosen: lit. pt. pass loosed Dn 3:25 (opp. bound); fig. loosen knots, i.e. solve difficulties, 5:12, 5:16. 2. abide (from loosening girths, loads, at encampment; cf. Targum NH [also on pt. pass]), fig. 2:22 (עִם pers). Pa. Pf. 3 mpl. שָׁרִיו Ezr 5:2 begin (v. BH III. [חָלַל] Hiph. 2), sq. inf. Hithpa. Pt. mpl. מִשְׁתָּרַ֫יִן Dn 5:6 joints were loosened (in fear).

title: שׁרק
content:
[Str8319] שׁרק (Targum שְׁרֵיק, Syr.ܫܪܩ, BH שָׁרַק hiss, whistle (onomatop.).

[Str4953] † [מַשְׁרוֺקִי] n.f. pipe (cf. Syr. (rare));—emph. מַשְׁרוֺקִיתָא Dn 3:5, 3:7, 3:15, ´מַשְׁרֹק: 3:10.

title: שֹׁ֫רֶשׁ
content:
[Str8328,8330] † [שֹׁ֫רֶשׁ] n.m.:Dn 4:12 root (v.BH);—pl. sf. שָׁרְשׁוֺ֫הִי of tree Dn 4:12, 4:20, 4:23.

[Str8332] † שרשו Kt (i.e. שֹׁרְשׁוּ K§ 61, 4, 5), Qr שְׁרשִׁי n.f. uprooting, fig. banishment;—abs. Ezr 7:26.

[Str8353] שֵׁת, שִָׁת six, v. שׁדת

title: שְׁתָה
content:
[Str8355,8354] † [שְׁתָה] vb. drink (Targum שְׁתָא, אִשְׁתִּי, Syr. ܐܬܝ; v. BH I. שָׁתָה);—Pe. Pf. 3 mpl. אִשְׁתִּיו (K§ 11, 4, a))Dn 5:3, 5:4; Impf. 3 mpl. יִשְׁתּוֺן v:2; Pt. act. שָׁתֵה v:1, pl. שָׁתַ֫יִן;—drink, acc. wine Dn 5:1, 5:4, + ב of vessel v:23 and (acc. om.) v:2, v:3.

[Str4960–61] † [מִשְׁתֵּי so Targum] n.m. feast (as BH מִשְׁתֶּה];—emph. בֵּית מִשְׁתְּיָא Dn 5:10.

title: שִׁתִּין
content:
[Str8361] שִׁתִּין sixty, v. שׁדת

[Str8370] † שְׁתַר בּוֺזְנַי n.pr.m. Pers. offcial Ezr 5:3, 5:6, 6:6, 6:13; Σαθαρβουζανα (αι, ε, ης); LXXL Σαθραβωζαης (AndrM 87 * prop. ´מתרב:, Gk. Μιθροβουζάνης, = OIran. *Mithrabaužana, Mithra is delieverer (or the like), Mey Entst, J.32; Scheft92 f. OIran. Šêtharabûzana, empire-delivering; WklMVAG 1887, 281 f. conj. a title).
